feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag bigyan ng pagkain, kendi o tubig ang hindi tumutugon, at hindi masasabi ng iisang palatandaan ang sanhi.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not give food, candy or water to an unresponsive person, and one clue cannot tell the cause.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Kapag ligtas ang paligid, humingi ng emergency help at suriin ang tugon at normal na paghinga.
feedback_by_option.en: Right. Once the scene is safe, activate emergency help and check response and normal breathing.

feedback_by_option.fil: Naaantala ang pagtawag kapag naghintay. Tumawag na at patuloy na magbantay.
feedback_by_option.en: Waiting delays emergency activation. Call now and keep watching.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Hindi pa rin siya tumutugon kaya walang ipaiinom; habang humihinga, bantayan hanggang dumating ang tulong.
feedback_by_option.en: Right. She still cannot respond, so nothing by mouth; while she breathes, keep watching until help arrives.

feedback_by_option.fil: Humihinga siya pero hindi pa rin tumutugon. Huwag bigyan ng pagkain, kendi o tubig.
feedback_by_option.en: She is breathing but still unresponsive. Do not give food, candy or water.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag hulaan ang sanhi mula sa iisang palatandaan. Iulat ang nakita.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not infer the cause from a single clue. Hand over what you observed.
